description: Knowledge lifecycle shapes (Epic 9, planning pass 2026-08-06, D1-D5 ruled). Provisional knowledge lives in the per-user store only (AD-3): the per-project spine at ~/.tk-studio/projects/<key>/knowledge/spine.md (D2) and per-run seeds as seed.md in run workspaces. lib/knowledge.py is the one validator (pure - no fs, no I/O); no other surface parses these shapes. Only promoted knowledge crosses to the project VCS, as ordinary kb/ files through a PR - review is the gate (D3, AD-12). Aid, not gate: a red or absent spine/seed never blocks a run.

artifact_frontmatter.note: spine.md / seed.md are markdown with flat YAML frontmatter; the body defines anchors as bracketed ids. Two tiers share the schema.

tier.note: spine: broad, once per project; seed: narrow, per run, inherits the spine

status.note: supersede header, verbatim - provisional knowledge is never canonical

authority.note: supersede header, verbatim (ported wire value, unchanged across drivers): authoritative in-flight, structurally incapable of becoming canonical by accident

run_id.note: the owning run; also the anchor-id middle

spine_ref.note: store-relative path to the project spine this seed inherits from

inherits.note: spine anchor ids this seed reuses verbatim; deltas may cite them

anchors.note: anchor ids are the join (immutable, append-only, never renumbered): SPINE-A<n> on the spine, SEED-<run-id>-A<n> on seeds. Deltas cite identity, not location, so corrections survive every edit. At least one anchor per artifact; duplicates reject; tier prefix must match the artifact tier (seeds may also cite inherited SPINE- ids).

delta.note: the closed correction shape. Deltas ride handoff.json as structured objects (deltas[] - session surface, ST-9.2); unanchored and dangling deltas are named rejections, never silently dropped.

anchor.note: an anchor id in the seed's available set (defined + inherited)

reality.note: what is actually true, compactly - deltas are pointers, not essays (handoff budget)

evidence.note: where reality was observed, e.g. path:line or a URL

tier.note: run-local corrects the seed; spine flags a project-spine assumption (source vocabulary mg-local renamed run-local in the port)

queue_line.note: one JSON object per line in the per-project reconciliation queue ~/.tk-studio/projects/<key>/knowledge/reconciliation-queue.jsonl (capture story ST-9.4; per-user store only, never project VCS). Dedupe key: (run_id, anchor, verdict, reality).

run_id.note: the run whose handoff carried the delta

grades.note: evidence grades on knowledge stay the studio's shipped A/B/C/D vocabulary (D1 ruling; contracts since 1.2.0 - see lib/research.py). Grade markers in artifact bodies are documentation, not validated shape. Source-vocabulary mapping for readers of first-driver artifacts:

promotion.note: promotion is drafted from the rendered routing doc into ordinary kb/ files on a branch; PR review is the human gate (D3) - nothing auto-applies, only a human writes canonical. kb frontmatter gains nothing; scope: stays reserved and unread (AD-8). Emits exactly one knowledge-promotion taxonomy event, sole emitter the promotion skill (D4) - taxonomy row lands with contract 1.7.0 (ST-9.5/9.6).
